# Data Source: stripe_billing_alert

Notifies you when the usage a billing meter records crosses a threshold.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stripe_billing_alert" "heavy_usage" {
  id = stripe_billing_alert.heavy_usage.id
}
```

## Argument Reference

This data source supports the following arguments:

* `id` - (Required) The ID of the billing alert to read.

## Attribute Reference

This data source exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `alert_type` - The type of alert to create. Possible values: `usage_threshold`.
* `livemode` - If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
* `status` - Status of the alert. This can be active, inactive or archived. Possible values: `active`, `archived`, `inactive`.
* `title` - The title of the alert.
* `usage_threshold` - The configuration of the usage threshold. See [`usage_threshold`](#usage_threshold) below.

<a id="usage_threshold"></a>
### `usage_threshold`

The `usage_threshold` attribute supports:

* `filters` - The filters allow limiting the scope of this usage alert. You can only specify up to one filter at this time. See [`usage_threshold.filters`](#usage_threshold.filters) below.
* `gte` - The value at which this alert will trigger.
* `meter` - The [Billing Meter](https://docs.stripe.com/api/billing/meter) ID whose usage is monitored.
* `recurrence` - Defines how the alert will behave. Possible values: `one_time`.

<a id="usage_threshold.filters"></a>
### `usage_threshold.filters`

The `usage_threshold.filters` attribute is a list. Each element supports:

* `customer` - Limit the scope of the alert to this customer ID
* `type` - Possible values: `customer`.
